description: Ferdinand Bolstraat 12-26 (1875-76): 6-8 m shop-street fronts of a shop ground floor and two upper storeys under a deep white entablature (architrave, plain or vented frieze, projecting cap) at 12.2 m; three equal axes of tall white T-windows with flat brick heads and white sills; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam centred over the middle axis; brick left red-brown or painted near-black

match.note: Ferdinand Bolstraat 12-26 (1875-76), 6.2-7.9 m; cornice 12.1-12.3 m on the 2023-01-03 strip at a 2.44 m camera height; 3DBAG eaves 11.7-12.4 m

pediment-dormer.note: 12-26: one white timber dormer, 1.8-1.9 m wide (0.36-0.64 of the front), over the middle axis, 12.3-14.4 m, under a pediment; the hoist beam projects from the pediment over the dormer window

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.identicalBays: both upper storeys: 3 T-windows of one width
rhythm.groundFloor: a shop per house, often a residential door at one party wall
rhythm.roofline: deep white entablature at 12.2 m; one pediment dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the square frieze vents of 12 are not drawn
the iron balconettes at the storey-1 and storey-2 sills of 12 are not drawn
the slightly cambered brick heads are flat

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023-01-03 (camera height 2.44 m) pands 5-6 (14, 12) at 1.5x with a metre grid: shop to 4.0-4.2 m, storey-1 windows 4.6-6.85 m, storey-2 windows 7.9-10.1 m, architrave 10.8-10.9 m, frieze (vents on 12) to 11.8 m, cornice cap to 12.2 m; windows 1.27 m wide on a 6.2 m front; dormer 12.3-14.4 m, 1.9 m wide, hoist beam over the apex
strip.jpg 2023-01-03 pands 1-4 (22-16): the same axes, entablature and dormers; 20, 18 and 16 painted near-black
strip.jpg 2023-01-03 pands 5-6 (26, 24): the same storeys (windows 4.7-6.9 and 7.9-10.2 m), entablature 10.9-12.3 m, a pediment dormer with a hoist beam to 14.6 m

notes: Palettes: the 2023-01-03 strips are overcast (walls read #4a-#5c grey); the red-brown is the sunlit tone of the same brick on the 2022-03-23 strip of Ferdinand Bolstraat 40-54; placed pands take their own measured wall.
